known_resolution: Fixed nested blueprint url_prefix concatenation when parent blueprint has empty prefix.
notes: Routing bug. Leakage hazard: withhold PR #4025.
issue_title: Nested blueprint url_prefix ignored when parent has no prefix
issue_body: Registering a child blueprint on a parent with url_prefix causes the child prefix to be ignored if parent prefix is empty.

known_resolution: Ensure json.dump passes kwargs to custom JSONEncoder.
notes: JSON encoding discrepancy. Leakage hazard: withhold PR #3955.
issue_title: Custom JSONEncoder kwargs dropped in flask.json.dump
issue_body: When calling flask.json.dump(..., sort_keys=True), extra kwargs are not forwarded to custom provider.

known_resolution: Preserve Content-Type header on redirect when method is changed from POST to GET.
notes: Redirect header handling. Leakage hazard: withhold PR #5205.
issue_title: Unexpected Content-Type header retention on 303 redirect
issue_body: On receiving a 303 See Other response, requests rewrites POST to GET but retains original Content-Type header.

known_resolution: Fix chunked encoding upload with generator bodies when content length is not set.
issue_title: Chunked upload hangs with generator body returning empty bytes
issue_body: Passing an empty generator or zero-byte chunk causes HTTP adapter to stall waiting for terminator.

known_resolution: Handle trailing slash correctly when merging base_url and relative path.
notes: URL path resolution bug. Leakage hazard: withhold PR #1225.
issue_title: base_url trailing slash stripped when joining relative path
issue_body: Client(base_url='https://example.com/api/') joining 'endpoint' produces 'https://example.com/endpoint' instead of '/api/endpoint'.

known_resolution: Prevent duplicate Proxy-Authorization headers on HTTPS CONNECT tunnels.
issue_title: Duplicate Proxy-Authorization headers sent during TLS tunnel handshake
issue_body: When establishing tunnel through authenticated HTTP proxy, header is injected twice causing 400 Bad Request.

known_resolution: Do not capture stdout during pytest_unconfigure hook when capture manager is torn down.
issue_title: AssertionError in capture manager during pytest_unconfigure
issue_body: Plugins printing output in pytest_unconfigure trigger AssertionError: capture manager already closed.

known_resolution: Support async fixtures with parametrize when scope is class or module.
issue_title: Parametrized class-scoped async fixture evaluated per function
issue_body: Async fixture marked scope='class' re-executes for each method when decorated with @pytest.mark.parametrize.

known_resolution: Fix Field(default_factory=...) deepcopy behavior on subclassed BaseModel.
issue_title: default_factory object mutated across model instances in child class
issue_body: Subclassing a BaseModel with Field(default_factory=list) shares the list instance when copied.

known_resolution: Correctly validate Union of Dict and List without raising TypeError in schema generation.
issue_title: TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict' when building OpenAPI schema for Union[dict, list]
issue_body: Generating OpenAPI schema for endpoint returning Union[dict, list] crashes in schema normalization.

known_resolution: Pass request state to sub-applications mounted via app.mount.
issue_title: request.state attributes not accessible in mounted FastAPI sub-apps
issue_body: Middleware setting request.state.user in root app does not propagate state to sub-app endpoints mounted with app.mount.

known_resolution: Correctly serialize custom exception response headers in ExceptionHandler.
issue_title: Custom HTTPException headers ignored when response_class is JSONResponse
issue_body: HTTPException(status_code=401, headers={'WWW-Authenticate': 'Bearer'}) omits header in output response.

known_resolution: Handle multiple Set-Cookie headers in Headers data structure without overwrite.
issue_title: Response.headers loses all but the last Set-Cookie value
issue_body: Adding multiple cookies through response.headers.add('Set-Cookie', ...) drops previous values on iteration.

known_resolution: Fix async loop.cycle helper in native environment.
notes: Async loop helper in native jinja environment.
issue_title: loop.cycle() raises RuntimeError inside async for block
issue_body: When rendering templates in AsyncEnvironment, calling loop.cycle('odd', 'even') fails with 'generator already executing'.

known_resolution: Preserve argument order when mutually exclusive option flags are processed.
issue_title: Positional argument parsing broken when option flag has negative prefix
issue_body: Passing --no-dry-run before positional file arguments causes parser to absorb the positional argument as option value.

known_resolution: Handle SSL EOF without close notify during connection pool clean up.
issue_title: SSLEOFError unhandled on stale connection pool recycle
issue_body: Reusing an idle HTTPS connection after server closes socket raises unhandled SSLEOFError instead of retrying.

known_resolution: Fix Table column width calculation when title contains ANSI escape sequences.
notes: ANSI width measuring in layout engine.
issue_title: Table layout misaligns columns when table title contains bold or color tags
issue_body: Console prints wrapped table rows prematurely because ANSI tag characters are counted toward visible column width.

known_resolution: Do not treat None as missing when field is explicitly declared allow_none=True.
issue_title: default=... overrides None value even when allow_none=True
issue_body: Deserializing {'value': None} on Field(default='xyz', allow_none=True) returns 'xyz' instead of None.

known_resolution: Preserve magic trailing commas inside multi-line bracketed generator expressions.
issue_title: Magic trailing comma removed from generator expression split across lines
issue_body: Formatting (x for x in items,) collapses into a single line without trailing comma.

known_resolution: Add token validation error check in validate_token to reject empty tokens.
notes: Local hermetic fixture case. Pinned to test fixture snapshot.
issue_title: Empty token accepted in TokenAuthenticator
issue_body: TokenAuthenticator does not raise an error when an empty string token is passed to validate_token.
